Why no internal_only? Condition: E nonempty AND all E addresses closed for that service. With ~1-2 external addresses per lease and per-service rows only sometimes present, "all E closed" requires rows for every E address for the same service. Since I generate rows per (address, service) with 65% probability, for 2+ E addresses it's rare, plus E addresses come from probes that echoed externally (a few per case), and unbound rows (event < witness) often drop... The witness event is up to 40 and app events are 0..60 or 5 → many unbound ✓ (unbound 434!). That's why little gets classified.
